# LakeAir

> LakeAir provides comprehensive air purification and ventilation solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial spaces, specializing in smoke removal, odor control, and HEPA filtration.

LakeAir offers a complete range of air purifiers from home units to industrial systems, with particular expertise in smoking room solutions, cigar lounges, and commercial applications. The site includes interactive calculators, technical guides, and product comparisons to help customers select appropriate air quality solutions.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filtration
- VOC removal
- Smoke removal
- Odor control
- Cigar lounges
- Commercial air purification
- Industrial air purifiers
- Activated carbon
- Electrostatic filtration
- HVAC design
- Ventilation sizing
- CFM requirements
- Maxum HEPA
- Air quality standards
- Smoke-eater technology
